fix.item: Updating only the link of an element (for example the url of a button) no longer adds a stray "type": "url" to its settings, which with older versions overwrote the style of the button

Addons that cannot render on the site (SP Page Builder Free renders only some of them) are refused by every write tool instead of being saved as elements that show nothing; allow_unrendered_addons saves them anyway
Emoji and other 4-byte characters are refused with an explanation when the table cannot store them (not utf8mb4), instead of letting MySQL reject the save or cut the text
Column widths stored by the editor ("33.33%") are left as they are
Option values are compared without case, as the editor stores some of them ("Left")

addition.item: New tool sppb_check_page: checks a page, or a layout before saving it, without changing anything: elements that cannot render, settings with no effect, invalid values, missing settings that cause PHP warnings, tab/accordion items that cannot hold rows, orphan rows and broken references, links to anchors that do not exist. Most issues come with the fix
sppb_get_site_info and sppb_list_addons report the SP Page Builder edition and the addons that cannot render on the site

fix.item: Section anchors work: the anchor is saved as settings.id, the key SP Page Builder renders (section_id and similar names are converted), and section settings are checked like addon settings
Elements created by the AI get every common setting with its default, as in the editor: no more PHP warnings on published pages with div containers
Colors without "type" (title_color and other advanced colors) are completed, so they are no longer ignored
Sizes with units such as "16px" in sliders (border radius, widths) are split into number and unit, so the CSS is valid (before: 16pxpx)
Invalid select values are not saved: the default is used and the warning says so
Tab and accordion items always get their list of rows: rows can be added to them, and text sent in an item becomes a row with a text block
Updating tab or accordion items without their content keeps the rows they hold
Element labels are saved as the editor does (admin_label): changing the text of a heading no longer renames it, and the new label argument renames sections and elements
sppb_replace_text only changes content by default (texts, links, image paths): option values such as "left" or "before" are no longer replaced by accident
Popups: units of reappear_after such as "days" are converted to the ones SP Page Builder knows, and trigger numbers are checked
sppb_list_pages also lists dynamic content pages, as the Pages list of SP Page Builder does
The page outline keeps a space between text blocks
The health audit counts addons as sppb_list_addons does

change.item: Tool results say more: list_versions (total and how many versions are kept), duplicate_node (map of the new IDs), insert_saved_section (outline of what was inserted), set_popup (saved trigger), update_page_settings (saved values), purge_page_css (why nothing was deleted), health_audit (verdict and actions)
sppb_get_addon_schema explains values, when a field applies and how to write typography, sliders, colors and links; it also returns the settings of sections and columns
sppb_get_page_full returns og_image as a path and can leave out the raw layout
Tool descriptions rewritten after a full test of the 33 tools from Claude Desktop

addition.item: Page structure of SP Page Builder 6: the AI reads and edits nested rows, div containers and the rows inside tab and accordion items
New tool sppb_get_node: read one section, column or element with its settings and position, without downloading the whole page
New tool sppb_move_node: move elements to another column or div, reorder elements, sections, nested rows and columns
New tool sppb_duplicate_node: duplicate an element or a section with everything inside it
New tools sppb_list_versions and sppb_restore_version: the AI can list the saved versions of a page and undo changes (the restore is reversible)
sppb_add_section creates nested rows in a column or rows in a tab/accordion item; sppb_add_addon adds into a div and at a chosen position
New tools sppb_find_nodes and sppb_replace_text: find elements by text or addon type and replace a text on a page or on the whole site, with a dry run first
New tools sppb_insert_saved_section and sppb_insert_saved_addon: insert sections and elements saved in the SP Page Builder library
Popups: create them with sppb_create_page and set where and when they appear with sppb_set_popup (stored as the editor does)
Pages get a language and a category; sppb_get_site_info lists the available ones

change.item: The page outline is a tree: nested rows, div children and tab/accordion rows appear where they are on the page, with heading levels, longer text and hidden devices
Deleting a section, column or element also removes everything nested in it, so no hidden leftovers stay in the page
When the site administrator enables read-only mode, the MCP server hides the write tools
Errors returned to the AI start with the HTTP status and its meaning (for example 409: page open in the editor)
Tool descriptions in the dashboard updated

fix.item: Pages created or edited by the AI open correctly in the SP Page Builder frontend editor: addons are saved with all their default settings, as the editor does (before, a missing setting left the frontend editor blank)
The compact addon schema no longer hides fields when two groups share a title (for example the custom colors of the button)

change.item: New test that opens the SP Page Builder frontend editor in a headless browser and fails on JavaScript errors

security.item: Deleting a page through the MCP moves it to the SP Page Builder trash: it stays recoverable with all its versions (before, the versions were deleted together with the page)

fix.item: Pages no longer break (HTTP 500) when the AI adds an addon without settings, such as a divider
A section title set by the AI is saved as an internal label instead of being shown on the page as a heading
Article layouts created by the AI are enabled, so they show on the article page
Changing part of a typography keeps the other values (font, weight, sizes on other devices)
A line height without unit is kept as a multiplier instead of becoming pixels
Duplicated pages keep nested rows and the content of tabs and accordions; the copy is unpublished
Shorter lists (accordion, tab items) replace the previous ones instead of keeping old items
Section and column backgrounds set by the AI are displayed; links without a type get their URL
Addon schemas that use SP Page Builder classes (articles, map, opt-in form) can be read

change.item: The bridge maps common setting mistakes to the SP Page Builder keys and returns warnings for unknown settings and invalid values
Addon schemas are compact, with translated labels and the settings every addon accepts
New pages are unpublished by default; page attributes are merged instead of replaced; the Open Graph image is stored in the editor format
The page list hides trashed pages and reports the total; tool descriptions and AI instructions corrected

addition.item: Article text backup: before an AI change to an article layout the article text is saved with the version snapshot, and restoring that version from the dashboard restores the text too
After every change the bridge cleans the Joomla cache of SP Page Builder and articles, and the page cache when the System - Page Cache plugin is enabled, so visitors see the new version right away
Explicit check for unsupported databases: the installer, the bridge and the dashboard state that only MySQL and MariaDB are supported

MCP clients tracked per user and per client type: a Claude Desktop extension and a local server of the same user no longer overwrite each other, and administrators see every client connected to the site with version, last use and status

Requests that do not report a client version (MCP servers older than 1.3.0, n8n, scripts) are listed as clients without version, with their User-Agent; clients not seen for 30 days are shown as no longer active
The MCP server contacts the site as soon as the AI client starts it, so the dashboard shows the connected client without waiting for the first tool call

change.item: Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3 or later are now required
Dashboard introduction: what the component does, how it protects the site and how to get started, with the installed versions
The Claude Desktop extension downloaded from the dashboard has the version in its file name (e.g. sppb-mcp-example-com-v1.5.1.mcpb)
Compatible with SP Page Builder 6.10: the edit lock is ignored when its "Disable padlock" option is enabled

addition.item: Changelog shown in Joomla: "Changelog" button in System > Update > Extensions and in System > Manage > Extensions

change.item: The build stops when the changelog has no entry for the version being released

addition.item: New sppb_get_site_info tool: site and administrator URLs, Joomla and SP Page Builder versions, URL settings
Every page result includes its URLs (frontend, friendly menu URL, SP Page Builder editor), so the AI can open the page and check the result
Joomla update server: new versions appear in System > Update > Extensions and install with one click (SHA-256/SHA-512 verified)

change.item: Dashboard redesigned with native Joomla 6 components: toolbar actions, native tabs, status table with a dedicated Actions column, standard history table
Server instructions include the site address and ask the AI to verify changes in a browser when one is available
Language files cleaned up

addition.item: Update notice when the MCP client (Claude Desktop extension or client package) is older than the version shipped by the site, both in the dashboard and in Claude
The bridge ping reports the component version and the latest client version

note.item: Claude Desktop extensions 1.2.0 do not report their version: update them once from the dashboard to receive future notices

addition.item: Claude Desktop extension (.mcpb) generated for each site: one-click install, site URL prefilled, API token stored securely by Claude Desktop
Ready-made prompts: analyze a page, create a landing page, edit a page, site health check
Server instructions that guide the AI to work safely (outline first, per-element edits, unpublished pages, confirmation before deleting)

security.item: Every change made through the MCP bridge and every rollback is written to Joomla's User Actions Log
Failed authentication attempts are logged to administrator/logs/sppb_mcp_auth.php; authentication errors are uniform and do not reveal which users exist
Write actions require POST; the API token is no longer embedded in the dashboard HTML
Explicit permission checks in the dashboard (charset conversion, rollback, client package download)
Input validation for addon names, column layouts and presets

fix.item: Saving an SP Page Builder layout on an article failed with error 500 on MySQL/MariaDB strict mode
Dates are stored in UTC as Joomla expects
Database connections with host:port, sockets, IPv6 and SSL
Not found pages return 404 instead of success

addition.item: Pages open in the SP Page Builder editor by another user are not modified (HTTP 409)
Option to limit the automatic MCP backups kept for each page

change.item: Every change runs in a database transaction with a page lock
MCP tool annotations (read-only and destructive tools); write tools hidden in read-only mode
Locked dependencies for the MCP client package

security.item: The component options (gateway, read-only mode, force HTTPS, allowed groups, snapshots) are now enforced by the bridge
Disabling the Joomla API token plugins also revokes access to the bridge
The API token is never created or re-enabled automatically: explicit Generate / Regenerate API Token action
Uninstalling the component removes the /api/sppb-mcp.php endpoint

fix.item: The installer no longer depends on the Joomla 6 backward compatibility plugin
Package archives built on Windows used backslash paths
